final:
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  post xs.len() >= 0
  ex swap_ends([]) == ()
  ex swap_ends([7]) == ()
  ex swap_ends([1, 2, 3]) == ()
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let first = xs[0]
    let last = xs[n - 1]
    xs[0] = last
    xs[n - 1] = first

test_swap_ends() =
  var a = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&a)
  assert a == [3, 2, 1]
  var b: List[int] = []
  swap_ends(&b)
  assert b == []
  var c = [5]
  swap_ends(&c)
  assert c == [5]
